procedures: Decode all91863orbit records with the frozen published ODF decoder; retain non-Doppler accounting.

Sort each stream by (nominal interval start,end,record). Record gaps, overlaps, duplicates and changes; split a contiguous nonoverlapping run whenever endpoint adjacency fails.
Compute window durations, chain lengths, dimensionless duration ratios and exact adjacent-window Gram diagonal/offdiagonal formulas from timing.

Optionally report the raw frequency weighted-variance functional on each complete chain, never call it a scalar residual, energy in physical units, error bar or exclusion. Keep every chain and bad/oneway stratum. No selection by values.
Preserve all outcomes and full chain ledger locally; compact timing summaries can be reviewed. Compare an independently decoded timing inventory before publication.
